'''Bender''' was a young [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] owned by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]]. A [[naming day]] gift from [[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] circa [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]], Bender was not much bigger than a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], with his name [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] on his left shoulder in both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]. Nirama kept him well fed, giving Bender small animals and allowing him to hunt them for himself.<ref name="T">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: TopWorld}}</ref>

==Biography==
In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], a secret movement within Nirama's [[Organization]] calling themselves [[the Cell]] stole Bender away from where Nirama was keeping him on [[Nirama's public asteroid]]. A couple of days later, they used him to test the prowess of a group of new recruits that had just started working on the asteroid, unleashing him upon them inside an abandoned restaurant, [[Mokada's Place]].<ref name="T" /> The recruits were actually spies for Nirama, and had heard him speak the name "Bender" earlier. Noticing the tattoos and realizing that Bender was only trying to play with them, not hunt them, the recruits were able to subdue the rancor without harming him, impressing the Cell. Later, after the spies were extracted from their mission, they reported Bender's location to Nirama. He immediately sent a squad to Mokada's, and they found him tied up in the kitchen.<ref name="T" /> Bender later died in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], after he was eaten by his father, [[Dinky]].<ref name="TheHand">{{LivingForce|EndTimes: The Hand}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bender's canonical fate was decided through a poll among the official [[RPGA]] playing teams of ''[[Between the Worlds: TopWorld|TopWorld]]''.
